summary: This component displays a list of blog posts that belong to the same series, fetching and filtering them by series name, then sorting chronologically. It wraps the list in a collapsible details section with a link to the series page, and marks the current post (if any) differently from the others so readers can see where they are in the series.

explanations.45: useBlogMetadata() returns all blog posts; we then chain .filter() and .sort() to get only posts in this series, ordered from oldest to newest by date.
explanations.47: new Date(a.date).getTime() converts the date string to milliseconds, so subtracting the two gives us a number we can use to sort in ascending order.
explanations.51: useSeriesLocalizer() looks up a translated label for the series name; the ?? series part means if no translation exists, fall back to using the series name itself.
explanations.53: If there are no posts in this series, return null so nothing renders — this keeps the component from showing an empty list.
explanations.74: We check if this post's permalink matches the excludePermalink prop, which tells us if this is the post the user is currently reading.
explanations.80: clsx() combines multiple CSS class names conditionally — it adds currentPostDimmed only if highlightCurrent is true, so we can apply different styles based on that prop.
